pairs.question: Viri, non magnus rex et multi homines? nec vinum praecellit? quis est ergo qui dominatur eorum?
pairs.answer: Nonne mulieres? genuerunt regem et omnem populum, qui dominantur mari et terrae.
pairs.derivation: Zorobabel poses his own question and answers it. Question span begins at the start of his speech (verse 14, after dropping the speech-tag narration 'tertius, qui dixerat de mulieribus et veritate, hic est Zorobabel, coepit loqui:') so that 'eorum' has its referent (rex, homines). Answer ends at the first full stop after 'terrae'; what follows (verse 16, 'et ex illis nati sunt...') is elaboration on women, so it is cut. Inline verse numbers stripped; capitalized first word and added terminal '?' are presentation only.

pairs.question: Quo permittente vobis aedificatis domum istam et opera haec fundatis?
pairs.answer: Nos sumus servi Domini, qui fecit caelum et terram.
pairs.derivation: The satraps' letter to Darius quotes their exchange with the elders. Question is the quoted utterance of verse 11 after dropping the speech tag 'tunc interrogavimus seniores dicentes:'. The intervening verse 12 ('ideo autem interrogavimus eos, ut notum faceremus tibi...') is meta-narration of why they asked, dropped as framing. Answer is the quoted utterance of verse 13 after dropping 'at illi responderunt nobis dicentes:'; it ends at the first full stop after 'terram', cutting verse 14's continued history ('et aedificabatur haec domus...'). Inline verse numbers stripped; first word capitalized.
